answer: In an agent marketplace buying terrace designs, trellis plans and timber estimates, each identity must keep a $100 bond locked while bidding and for 30 days after its last bid. Each identity gets one bid per job, and bonds cannot back multiple identities. An attacker flooding a job with 1,000 fake agents must therefore immobilize $100,000, paying financing costs and losing access to that capital. More identities require proportionally more money.
